summary: Further direction from City Council is required on this matter which has been appealed to the Ontario Municipal Board.
decided: City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 19, 2018) from the City Solicitor, as amended by the confidential instructions to staff attached to motion 1 by Councillor Joe Mihevc. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 19, 2018) from the City Solicitor as amended by the confidential instructions to staff attached to motion 1 by Councillor Joe Mihevc, and City Council authorize the public release of Confidential Appendices A and B to the report (March 19, 2018) from the City Solicitor. 3. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 19, 2018) from the City Solicitor remain confidential as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege. The confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 19, 2018) from the City Solicitor were adopted by City Council, as amended by the confidential instructions to staff attached to motion 1 by Councillor Joe Mihevc, and are now public, as follows: 1.
